reviewed_by: Claude: encrypted saved passwords for agents
reason: Adds an AES-256-GCM credential file store (store: refs, 0600 key under the Core data root), a SavedCredential entity and /api/v1/saved-credentials routes (host settings + kernel), {{credential:<name>}} substitution and echo scrubbing inside McpToolPlugin.execute with a per-password MCP server allow list, a credentials.list tool for chats/Butler whose selected servers can use one, Butler read access with browser-owned writes, and a Settings > Saved passwords section. Python selects the new saved-credential tests plus the credential, MCP inline-output, settings-assistant API, host-settings and runtime-bundle suites it touches. Frontend selects the assistant action tests (catalog discovery + open_setting) and the new component test. Playwright runs universal settings search at desktop and narrow width.
exclusions: test_tolerant_entity_readers.py::test_a_new_entity_field_needs_a_reviewed_addition_flag, test_settings_assistant_tools.py (2 count assertions) and test_butler_capabilities.py::test_scheduled_butler_can_edit_all_assistant_settings fail identically on origin/main and are not selected. No native change. Real-Core journey (save via browser, chat lists and enters a password through a stdio MCP echo server, other server refused, no plaintext in the data root) was run on a disposable LAN Core instead of a Playwright real-Core spec.
